mentions.name: Sumthings
mentions.description: This app for collectors provides an inbuilt, curated database where users can mark items as having, wanting, and/or selling. An inbuilt marketplace is planned soon, with links to external sales currently covering the supply side. It launches niche, covering Neo Geo games, systems, and accessories.
mentions.audience: Collectors, starting with Neo Geo games, systems, and accessories collectors
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an app for collectors that comes with an inbuilt, curated database where users can mark things as having, wanting and/or selling. It will have an invuilt marketplace soon, but currently I'm using links to external sales to cover the supply side. I'm also starting very niche by just covering Neo Geo games, systems and accessories for starters. https://sumthings.com
